answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 36796 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to a man who belongs to a caste except Sayyids (ex: Shaikh, Pathan etc) to marry a girl who belongs to a family of Sayyid or Sayyad-us-Sadat? Please reply in the light of hadith Question: Is it permissible to a man who belongs to a caste except Sayyids (ex: Shaikh, Pathan etc) to marry a girl who belongs to a family of Sayyid or Sayyad-us-Sadat? Please reply in the light of hadith. Answer ID: 36796 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 368/244/D=1433) If the girl and her wali (guardian) agree, then he can do nikah with her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
